# gigahost_region (Data Source)

Looks up one deploy region by slug (`sfj`), name (`sandefjord`), or short name (`SFJ, NO`). List regions with `gigahost deploy regions`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a region by slug, name, or short name.
data "gigahost_region" "sfj" {
  name = "sfj"
}

resource "gigahost_server" "web" {
  type   = "value"
  size   = "2c-4gb-40gb"
  os     = "debian-12"
  region = data.gigahost_region.sfj.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Region slug, name, or short name to look up. Filled with the canonical region name.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean)
- `country` (String)
- `name_short` (String)
- `slug` (String) Region slug for `gigahost_server.region`.
